authority.alpha_prerequisite: Implement the first D-01 installed walking product that a UI can start against: one primary rrflow executable deterministically previews and applies a local installation, opens only the installed instance, serves the existing generated capability/endpoint/OpenAPI projections, proves an authenticated readiness challenge, and performs mutation-free offline verification. This package is prerequisite evidence only and cannot close D-01, D-02 through D-11, POAM-006, POAM-007, POAM-013, POAM-016, POAM-020, POAM-025, a J gate, or the alpha objective.

current_behavior: At clean baseline 2f686f99, the primary rrflow binary exposes development and direct operator commands but no version, install, serve, ready, or installed verify lifecycle. Running the built binary with `version` or `install plan` exits 2 with an unrecognized-subcommand error. CLI startup defaults to .rrflow/rrd and calls the old project-manifest path before most commands. RrflowKvStore::open creates absent or empty storage and reconciles physical checkpoints; RrdEngine::open delegates to it and load_or_create_token_key can manufacture credentials on normal open. ManifestStore::open creates directories and MANIFEST.LOCK, so it cannot back mutation-free verification. InstallationPlan and AttunementPlan hash caller-supplied planned_at_unix_ms, preventing byte-identical repeated planning. Security initialization and the first runtime seat commit are separate durable transactions. The reusable HTTP server already exposes generated capabilities, endpoint catalogue, and OpenAPI, and the Rust client already proves API-key session authentication, but the primary binary does not compose them as an installed product.
target_behavior: Add an honest, locally usable D-01 walking product without inventing a second engine. The versioned installation/attunement plans become clock-free deterministic values. A bundle-resident generic default profile drives one pure `rrflow install plan --project --mode --profile` JSON projection over the current executable digest, profile digest, managed-path preconditions, project/estate/instance/storage identities, initial provider-neutral seat, explicit operator grants, credential sink, inactive optional capabilities, action order, estimates, and removal ownership. `install apply` accepts the exact plan and expected digest, revalidates preconditions before mutation, creates one plan-addressed rrflowKV root, prepares owner-only token/API credentials without printing secrets, and invokes one RrdEngine initializer whose single authoritative storage transaction commits the initial runtime seat/schema together with installed binding, security authority, audit, install checkpoint/evidence, deterministic attunement plan, and pending attunement job. Only after readback does it durably publish the minimal non-secret .rrflow/config.toml locator. Explicit create_new/open_existing APIs are added and the installed path never uses create-on-open or load-or-create credentials. A separate shared-lock read-only physical inspector authenticates CURRENT, the complete manifest ancestry, reachable segments, and the contiguous WAL without creating or repairing any path; RrdEngine layers locator, installed-record, security, attunement, credential-permission, build/profile, and runtime-coordinate checks into `rrflow verify --level quick`. `rrflow serve` links the reusable server library in the primary process. `rrflow ready` resolves the locator, authenticates the previewed credential by creating a bounded session, reads readiness/capabilities, closes the session, and emits a redacted machine-readable proof. Real-process tests prove version, byte-identical/no-write plan, exact apply, secret redaction and permissions, dynamic discovery, authenticated ready, one API commit/query, process close/reopen, and byte-stable quick verify.
unchanged_behavior: README maturity, objective, roadmap, POA&M, and Gate D status remain owner-controlled and open; README may replace its obsolete command-absence baseline with a linked, bounded first-slice fact, but this walking product is not D-01 or alpha closure.
Product version remains 1.0.0. No version bump, benchmark threshold change, storage promotion, tag, release, official-origin push, or distribution-signing claim is made.

RrdEngine remains the sole durable-effect authority. The installation contract types effects, identities, inputs, budgets, and receipts; it does not model exploratory thought or constrain private reasoning under ADR-0002.

rrflowKV remains the only durable default store, rrflowMX remains the volatile conformance profile, and Arrow/DataFusion remain in-process compute. No sibling checkout, external database, network fetch, provider, generator, model, or subprocess is required for installation or readiness.

Existing runtime mutations, endpoint dispatch, OpenAPI generation, SDK operation identity, query semantics, WAL bytes, durability acknowledgement, storage formats, backup data, and project-owned files are not weakened or silently migrated.

The generic profile does not install this repository's Clyffy persona or activate any provider representation. It creates a provider-neutral seat and exposes provider/generator/model candidates as inactive future attunement capabilities.

Secrets are generated only during exact apply, written only to previewed owner-only sinks, hashed before persistence, redacted from output/traces/errors, and never placed in the locator, plan, Git evidence, or UI discovery catalogue.

The old development supervisor, standalone server/bootstrap/controller binaries, InstanceManifest startup binding, and legacy create-or-open APIs remain implementation inventory during this first replacement proof. They are not used by the new path and cannot satisfy acceptance; D-01 remains open until a following direct-convergence package supplies parity and deletes them.

Full verification, repair, restore publication, salvage, uninstall, durable attunement execution, project inventory/parsing, streamed DataFusion, cross-platform release assembly, hostile concurrent path-replacement qualification, and fixed-hardware promotion remain later Gate D/F/J work.

No implementation file is deleted, moved, or renamed in this package. New installed and inspection modules are canonical destinations, not fallback implementations; legacy removal is explicitly blocked until replacement evidence exists.

sources.title: Rust std::fs::OpenOptions::create_new
sources.retained_behavior: Use atomic create-new semantics for credential, lock, temporary locator, and collision-sensitive files; a dangling symlink also fails.
sources.rejected_assumption: A prior exists() check plus create(true) is a safe installation lease or credential sink.

sources.title: Rust std::fs::File locking
sources.retained_behavior: Use the existing manifest lock as an exclusive writer/shared offline-inspector exclusion primitive without creating it during inspection.
sources.rejected_assumption: A readable database path or successful TCP connection proves it is safe for offline verification.

sources.title: Linux openat2(2)
sources.retained_behavior: Treat beneath/no-symlink/no-magic-link resolution as the hostile-path qualification target and revalidate canonical containment in this portable first slice.
sources.rejected_assumption: Portable canonicalize-then-open fully closes concurrent path-replacement attacks; that adversarial qualification remains open.

sources.retained_behavior: Sync file content then parent-directory metadata at credential/root/locator publication boundaries using the repository's platform abstraction.
sources.rejected_assumption: Renaming a file or syncing only its contents universally proves the directory entry durable.

stop_conditions: Planning or installed open would need an undeclared network fetch, sibling checkout, external database/provider/model, project command, supervisor marker, companion executable, or provider-owned hook to reach readiness.

The plan cannot be byte-identical over unchanged inputs without omitting an effect, secret policy, precondition, digest, identity, budget, ownership/removal rule, or inactive candidate that this slice actually performs.
Any planning path writes, creates a lock/database/credential/config, reads a secret, binds a socket, invokes a command, or activates an adapter.

Exact apply would silently re-plan, accept a stale/wrong digest or mode, overwrite an unowned path, follow an unreviewed link outside the project, reuse foreign partial state, print a secret, or publish the locator before engine readback.

Initialization cannot commit runtime seat/schema plus installed record, security state/audit, install checkpoint/evidence, attunement plan/job, outbox, and cursor through one physical Authoritative transaction.

Installed open or verify calls legacy create-or-open/load-or-create/startup-binding/checkpoint-reconciliation paths; quick verification creates, modifies, truncates, repairs, or deletes any target byte.
Read-only inspection cannot exclude a live writer or authenticate CURRENT, its complete manifest lineage, every reachable segment, and the contiguous WAL without mutation.
Authenticated ready can succeed using only a PID, marker, port/TCP check, public readiness document, missing/wrong credential, mismatched instance/build/profile, or a failed bounded engine operation.
Dynamic discovery requires a new hand-maintained UI schema or capability table instead of the executable catalogues/OpenAPI/product capability projection.

A test requires exposing credential bytes, weakening permissions/authorization/durability, changing storage format or promotion threshold, bypassing RrdEngine, or treating eager DataFusion as streamed.

Cargo.lock changes without an explained locked first-party composition need, product version/maturity/gate-status changes, generated navigation/inventory drifts, any owning suite regresses, or scope expands into full attunement/repair/release qualification.

Replacement proof is insufficient to delete a legacy initializer/supervisor/controller path safely; retain it as explicitly non-acceptance inventory and schedule direct convergence rather than deleting behavior without parity.
